scope: One shared generated saved-trails brief and one independent live ballot. Context retrieval, hosted keyboard replay, scores and pixel diagnosis are distinct measures.
contrast_note: After removal, text changes immediately while the background follows a 150 ms transition. The edge frame catches the low-contrast interval. The pixel sample measures the brightest text against the modal local background.
decision: Design MCP won this matched brief at both widths. Neither page met the release threshold. Preserve the exact frozen pair.

calibration.example: Legible repair intake with clear labels, familiar layout, and misplaced focus after an invalid number.
calibration.basis: Clear labels and a familiar layout support the task; misplaced error focus is a material usability weakness. These scores are estimates from the supplied description, not a live review.

primary_action.expected: Reach the Cedar Bend suggestion and save it.
primary_action.observed: The first Tab reached Save Cedar Bend. Enter produced one saved Cedar Bend and a count of 1; focus moved to Remove Cedar Bend.

A-1440.edge_observation: Enter on Remove restored the empty state, 0 count, and actionable suggestion at the same URL, with focus on Save Cedar Bend.
A-1440.fact_check: Cedar Bend and 2.4 miles were visible in the initial viewport before action. The task required no guessing.
A-1440.strength: The large trail illustration and adjacent suggestion make the empty collection feel purposeful while keeping the action prominent.
A-1440.weakness: The illustration takes more space than the route information, and the post-removal button appeared temporarily low contrast in the edge capture.
A-1440.repair: Give the route details more emphasis and ensure the focused save button remains legible throughout state changes.

primary_action.expected: Reach the Cedar Bend suggestion and save it.
primary_action.observed: The first Tab reached Save Cedar Bend. Enter produced one saved Cedar Bend and a count of 1, with focus on Remove Cedar Bend.

A-390.edge_observation: Enter on Remove restored the empty state and actionable suggestion at the same URL, retaining focus on Save Cedar Bend.
A-390.fact_check: Cedar Bend and 2.4 miles were visible in the initial viewport before action. The task required no guessing.
A-390.strength: The stacked layout keeps the route and named action visible together on the initial screen.
A-390.weakness: The tall illustration and introductory copy leave the save button close to the bottom of the initial viewport.
A-390.repair: Reduce the height of the introductory area on narrow screens so the suggestion has more breathing room.

primary_action.expected: Reach the Cedar Bend suggestion and save it.
primary_action.observed: The first Tab reached Save trail. Enter produced one saved Cedar Bend and a count of 1; focus moved to Remove.

B-1440.edge_observation: Enter on Remove restored the empty panel and actionable suggestion at the same URL, with focus returned to Save trail.
B-1440.fact_check: Cedar Bend and 2.4 miles were visible in the initial viewport before action. The task required no guessing in the visible card context.
B-1440.strength: The distinct empty and suggested panels clearly separate the collection from the proposed trail, and the focus indicator is conspicuous.
B-1440.weakness: The generic Save trail label is less descriptive when encountered outside its visual card context.
B-1440.repair: Give the save control an accessible name that includes Cedar Bend.
save_keyboard_transition: Remove Cedar Bend from saved trails
remove_keyboard_transition: Remove Cedar Bend from saved trails

primary_action.expected: Find the suggestion, verify its distance, and save it.
primary_action.observed: The first Tab reached Save trail and scrolled its card into view, revealing Cedar Bend and 2.4 miles. Enter produced one saved Cedar Bend and a count of 1.

B-390.edge_observation: Enter on the focused Remove control restored the empty state and suggestion at the same URL; focus returned to Save trail and the page scrolled to it.
B-390.fact_check: The route name and distance were below the initial viewport, but both were visible after Tab and before activation. The task was possible without guessing.
B-390.strength: Keyboard focus brings the complete suggestion into view, and the saved card is compact and clear.
B-390.weakness: The large empty-state panel pushes the route name, distance, and action below the initial viewport.
B-390.repair: Shorten the empty-state panel or bring the suggestion details higher on narrow screens.
save_keyboard_transition: Remove Cedar Bend from saved trails
remove_keyboard_transition: Remove Cedar Bend from saved trails

preference.reason: Both designs completed the tested keyboard cycle and restored the suggestion without changing URL. A makes the named route and distance visible immediately at both widths, and its save control names the route. B requires scrolling or focus navigation to reveal those details on the phone.

unsupported_claims: The displayed 2.4-mile distance was confirmed in the interface; its real-world accuracy was not independently verified.
Persistence across reloads and behavior beyond the tested save and removal cycle were not tested.
